οὔτασε: οὐτάω — wound (by a thrust), stab; aor. 3 sg. act.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg., with μάχης · also fem. gen. sg., with ὁμηλικίης: ’all’ (περὶ πάσης ὁμηλικίης ’above all his age-mates’)
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
πέσε: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσε)
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’
παραστὰς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔστην): ’standing beside’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πατρόκλῳ: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. dat. sg.
παυρότεροι: παῦρος — few, little; comparative παυρότερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’fewer, scantier in number’
παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
πελασγοῦ: Πελασγός — a Pelasgian; masc. gen. sg., with Λήθοιο
πελώριος: πελώριος — monstrous, huge; masc. nom. sg., predicate · also masc. nom. sg., in apposition to a name: ’huge’ (Ἀΐδης … πελώριος ’huge Hades’)
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πεσόντ: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. dual, elided (πεσόντ’ = πεσόντε): ’the two as they fell’
πεσών: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
πεσὼν: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (aor. stem πεσ-): ’having fallen’
πλῆξ: πλήσσω — strike; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (πλῆξ’ = πλῆξε, Attic ἔπληξε): ’struck’
ποδὸς: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’ · also masc. gen. sg., of the part: ’of the foot’ (ταρσὸν ποδὸς ’the sole of the foot’) · also after ἐκ: ’out of the foot’ (ἐκ ποδὸς ἕλκε)
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέμιζον: πολεμίζω — fight, wage war; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολέμιζον), + dat.: ’fought against’
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
πολέσσ: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic πολέσσι (= Attic πολλοῖς), elided
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’ · also neut. acc. sg. adjective, agreeing with φῦκος: ’much (seaweed)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱδρῶ: ’much (sweat)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with τρόφι: ’greatly’ (πολλὸν … τρόφι ’greatly swollen’)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
πραπίδων: πραπίδες — midriff, the parts about the liver; fem. gen. pl. (plural only), after ὑπό: ’beneath the midriff’
πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
προμάχεσθαι: προμάχομαι — fight in front of, be foremost in battle; pres. inf. mid./dep., + gen. of those surpassed, after ἔθελεν: ’to be foremost’
προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρόμαχοι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. nom. pl.
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’) · also adv. in διὰ πρό, ’right through’ (διὰ πρὸ … ἐλάσσαι ’drive right through’)
πυρός: πῦρ — fire; neut. gen. sg., partitive: ’a share of fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., with μαλεροῦ, of the means after ἐμπρήσειν: ’with devouring fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on αὐγῇ: ’of the fire’ (ἐν πυρὸς αὐγῇ ’in the glare of the fire’)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδα: πούς — foot; masc. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the foot’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’foot’ of a mountain, after ὑπαί (πόδα νείατον Ἴδης)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
σθένεΐ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg. σθένεϊ with diaeresis (= σθένει): dat. of respect, ’in strength’
σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
στονόεντα: στονόεις — full of groaning, grievous; neut. acc. pl., epic -όεντα, agreeing with βέλεα
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σχεδίον: Σχεδίος — Schedius, a Phocian leader, son of Perimedes; masc. acc. sg., proper name
σχεδόθεν: σχεδόθεν — from near, close at hand; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
σῶν: σῶς (σάος, σόος) — safe, sound; masc. acc. sg., contracted (σῶν = σόον): ’safe’ · also σός, σή, σόν (possessive) — your; neut. gen. pl. (σῶν ὀχέων ’your chariot’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τένοντας: τένων — sinew, tendon; masc. acc. pl.
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθνηῶτα: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτα): ’dead’
τελαμῶνι: τελαμών — strap, baldric; masc. dat. sg.: ’with the strap’ · also Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax and Teucer; masc. dat. sg., proper name
τελαμῶνος: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. gen. sg. · also Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax; masc. gen. sg.
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοκεῦσι: τοκεύς — parent (usually pl. ’parents’); masc. dat. pl.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυτθόν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used as adv.: ’a little (way)’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’)
τύψε: τύπτω — strike, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= ἔτυψε): ’struck’
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῆλ: τῆλε (elided τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’ · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’own, dear’ (φίλα γούνατα ’my own knees’) · also neut. acc. pl., predicate: ’dear, pleasing’ (φίλα ἀγορεύεις ’say pleasing things’)
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
φαίης: φημί — say; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you would say’
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φαίνοπος: Φαίνοψ — Phaenops, father of Xanthus and Thoon; masc. gen. sg.
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωκήων: Φωκεῖς — the Phocians; masc. gen. pl., epic Φωκήων (= Attic Φωκέων)
φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
φόρκυν: Φόρκυς — Phorcys, a captain among the allies; masc. acc. sg., proper name
φύζαν: φύζα — panic flight, rout; fem. acc. sg.
φῶτε: φώς — man, fighter; masc. acc. dual: ’two men’
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’)
χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
χαλκοπαρῄου: χαλκοπάρῃος — bronze-cheeked; fem. gen. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κυνέης
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χαριζόμενος: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’gratifying, pleasing’
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’ · also fem. gen. pl. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hands’ (θρασειάων ἀπὸ χειρῶν ’from the bold hands’)
χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
χώρησαν: χωρέω — give way, withdraw; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐχώρησαν): ’gave way, fell back’
ἀγοστῷ: ἀγοστός — crook of the arm, hollow of the hand; masc. dat. sg., instrumental
ἀγοὶ: ἀγός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
ἀκόντισε: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, throw a spear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠκόντισε): ’hurled’
ἀλεξέμεναι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀλέξειν): ’to defend’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοις: ἀλλήλων — one another, each other; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl.: ’at one another’ · also masc. dat. pl., of exchange: ’with one another’
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’) · also gen. pl. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἰθυνομένων ’as they aimed at one another’) · also gen. pl. as object of ἐφικνέομαι: ’of one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἐφίκοντο ’got hold of one another’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἤμβροτον: ’one another’ (ἤμβροτον ἀλλήλων ’missed one another’)
ἀμπερὲς: ἀμπερές — right through, straight through; adv.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’) · also + gen., ’about, over’ (ἀμφ’ ὀλίγης πίδακος ’about a small spring’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc. gen. sg.
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along, through; prep. + acc.: ’up through, throughout’
ἀνάσσων: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’ruling’
ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
ἀνέρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. dual, epic ἀνέρε (= Attic ἄνδρε): ’two men’ · also masc. nom. dual: ’two men’
ἀναλκείῃσι: ἀναλκείη — lack of strength, cowardice; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’through cowardice’
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπέδωκε: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, pay back; aor. 3 sg. act., κ-aorist (= Attic ἀπέδωκεν): ’paid back’
ἀπισάονα: Ἀπισάων — Apisaon, son of Phausias (a different Apisaon, son of Hippasus, is a Paeonian); masc. acc. sg.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀράβησε: ἀραβέω — clatter, rattle; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠράβησε)
ἀρήϊος: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; masc. nom. sg.
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
ἀρηϊφίλων: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. gen. pl.
ἀριστεύεσκε: ἀριστεύω — be the best, excel; iterative impf. 3 sg. act., epic -εσκε: ’used to excel’
ἀστεροπαῖον: Ἀστεροπαῖος — Asteropaeus, a Paeonian ally of the Trojans; masc. acc. sg.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄγχ: ἄγχι — near, close by; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἄγχ’ = ἄγχι): ’near Ajax’
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄνδρεσσιν: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’the best (thing)’ (ὃ … ἄριστον … εἴη ’that would be the best’)
ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐεισάμενος: εἴδομαι — seem; make oneself like (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐεισάμενος: ’having likened himself (to)’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλέησεν: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable), + acc.: ’pitied’
ἐλελίχθησαν: ἐλελίζω — make whirl, wheel round; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic reduplicated: ’wheeled round’
ἐμαρνάσθην: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 dual mid., -άσθην: ’the two fought’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναντίοι: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. pl.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐξάλμενος: ἐξάλλομαι — leap out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (= ἐξαλάμενος): ’having leapt out’
ἐξοπίσω: ἐξοπίσω — backward, behind, to the rear; adv. (of time, ’hereafter’)
ἐοικὼς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
ἐπαΐξας: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἐπετέλλετο: ἐπιτέλλομαι — charge, give orders to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’gave his charge’
ἐπικούρων: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. gen. pl.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro, go round to; go at, attack; impf. 3 sg.
ἐριβώλακος: ἐριβώλαξ — rich-soiled, with big clods; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., with Τάρνης
ἐρύκακεν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act., epic reduplicated ἐρύκακε(ν) (= Attic ἔρυξε), ν-movable; with κέν: ’could have held back’
ἐρύσαντο: ἐρύω — draw, drag away; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’drew off, dragged away’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἑσταότες: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ἑσταότες (= Attic ἑστῶτες): ’standing’
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
ἔγχεΐ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., instrumental, epic ἔγχεϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’ · also ’set free, released’ (a captive, for ransom)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔντερα: ἔντερον — bowel, intestine; neut. acc. pl.
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος, + gen. of comparison: ’choice beyond (others)’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, + gen. of comparison: ’above (others)’ (ἔξοχον ἄλλων)
ἔπασχον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; impf. 3 pl.: ’were suffering’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I was suffering’ (with κε: ’I would have suffered’)
ἔπιπτον: πίπτω — fall; impf. 3 pl. act.: ’were falling’
ἔπλεθ: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided and aspirated (ἔπλεθ’ = ἔπλετο): ’was, came to be’
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσταν: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans., epic (= Attic ἔστησαν): ’stood’
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαντο: φημί — say; mid. ’think, suppose’; impf. mid. 3 pl. (= Attic ἔφασαν), + fut. inf.: ’they said, they supposed (he would …)’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχοντας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’having, possessing’
ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’)
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’ · also in battle: ’killed’ (ἕλον ἄνδρα ’killed a man’)
ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; plpf. 3 pl., intransitive (= Attic εἱστήκεσαν): ’stood, were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’
ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
ἠλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= ἠλεύσατο, σ dropped): ’avoided’
ἠνορέῃ: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἀνδρεία)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤφυσ: ἀφύσσω — draw out, scoop out; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἤφυσ’ = ἤφυσε): ’drew out’
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’)
ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰφίτου: Ἴφιτος — Iphitus, father of Schedius and Epistrophus; masc. gen. sg.
ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’hastening’
ἱππασίδην: Ἱππασίδης — son of Hippasus (Charops); masc. acc. sg., patronymic
ἱππόθοος: Ἱππόθοος — Hippothous, a Pelasgian leader; masc. nom. sg.
ἱππόθοόν: Ἱππόθοος — Hippothous, a captain among the allies; masc. acc. sg., proper name
ἴαχον: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they shouted’
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴθυσεν: ἰθύω — rush straight on, charge; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’charged’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀτρύνων: ὀτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’urging’
ὁμάδῳ: ὅμαδος — din, uproar, noise of a crowd; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a roar’
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπερμενέων: ὑπερμενής — of exceeding might, overweening; adj., masc. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
ὑπό: ὑπό — under, beneath; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑπό … ἔλλαβε ’seized from beneath’); accented before the enclitic τε
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὑσμίνην: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg.
ὕπατον: ὕπατος — highest, supreme (superl. of ὕπερ); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Κρονίδην
ὠτειλῆς: ὠτειλή — wound; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ῆς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥῆξε: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
